title: [AAPS 3.0.0] BG Check input x mmol/l from AAPS is shown x/18 mmol/l in NSClient
body:
Input x mmol/l in AAPS BG Check (Actions tab). It is shown correctly in AAPS screen and Treatments.
When using NSClient and data is synchronised into NS and NSClient, BG value is shown as a verly low value in NSClient screen and in Treatments it's value is x/18 mmol/l. It seems to be shown as a vely low value also in NightScout screen but I am not sure what it is in NS database.

comments.body: It seems to be the same problem also in other direction, NSClient -> AAPS when entering BGCheck from NSClient.

It is a Nightscout bug, not an aaps bug, it has been fixed (but I don't know if it's on latest release of NS or not).
See #1085 and https://github.com/nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor/pull/7273/files
